create.name: Evolving Wisdom
create.bio:
Evolving Wisdom is an online school for spiritual and personal transformation, run as a small company from San Rafael in Marin County, California. It was started by the spiritual teacher Craig Hamilton and the women's empowerment teacher Claire Zammit, and it works almost entirely through virtual classrooms: multi-week courses taught live over video, with recorded sessions, practice assignments and online communities of students from many countries. Rather than offering single talks, its programmes are built to take students through a sustained process of change over several weeks.

The teaching centres on meditation and awakening, conscious evolution, life purpose and the spiritual life. Craig Hamilton leads a twelve-week meditation training, the Practice of Direct Awakening, a nine-week course called Integral Enlightenment on living in step with evolution, and an ongoing monthly membership for students who want to keep practising together. Claire Zammit teaches Feminine Power, a seven-week course for women. Guest faculty run courses of their own through the school, among them the human-potential pioneer Jean Houston, on life purpose and latent capacities, and Neale Donald Walsch, author of the Conversations with God books. Free entry points include an introductory online class on Craig's meditation approach and his podcast, Meditation Changes Everything.

courses.title: Practice of Direct Awakening
courses.description: Craig Hamilton's twelve-week online meditation course, followed from home over consecutive weeks. Students learn to rest directly in awakened awareness rather than working towards it, and to carry that practice into ordinary daily life.

courses.title: Integral Enlightenment
courses.description: Craig Hamilton's nine-week online course on conscious evolution: finding a deeper source of energy and creativity, and a sense of meaning that comes from aligning one's life with the evolutionary impulse.

courses.title: Awakened Life Monthly Membership
courses.description: An ongoing membership with Craig Hamilton for people keeping up a direct-awakening practice. Each month brings a practice theme, four weekly guided audio meditations, a written practice guide and a live video session with Craig once a month.

courses.title: Feminine Power: The Essential Course for the Awakening Woman
courses.description: Claire Zammit's seven-week online course for women, with guided practices and live group sessions. It works with the inner patterns that hold women back and with a felt, intuitive way of finding direction in life.

courses.title: Unlock Your Quantum Powers
courses.description: A seven-week online training with Jean Houston on five latent capacities she calls quantum powers, such as a more spacious sense of time and the ability to draw in what a project needs, with live group coaching and practical exercises.

courses.title: Awakening to Your Life's Purpose
courses.description: Jean Houston's seven-week online course on recognising a personal calling and arranging life around it, through live group coaching, reflection and practical exercises.

courses.title: Conversations with God
courses.description: A seven-week online course in which Neale Donald Walsch distils the main ideas of his Conversations with God books into practical steps for a personal, everyday relationship with the Divine.

courses.title: Living From Your Soul
courses.description: A nine-week online programme with Neale Donald Walsch built around three stages, awaken, connect and live from the soul, with weekly guided sessions and tools for living more authentically.

free_resources.title: Meditation 2.0: Free Online Class
free_resources.description: A free online seminar with Craig Hamilton introducing his direct-awakening approach to meditation, including why a busy mind need not get in the way. Registration adds you to the school's email lists.

free_resources.title: Meditation Changes Everything (podcast)
free_resources.description: Craig Hamilton's free podcast of short teachings and guided practices on meditation, letting go and non-duality, with some sixty episodes so far.
